description: Chunky original 8-bit pixel art with stepped silhouettes and dark navy outlines. Environments use muted mint grass, warm sandy cream, or pale aqua pool tiles; critters use vivid lime, butter yellow, coral, and lavender against those backgrounds. Water hazards sparkle electric blue and white, while pickups carry warm gold borders. Flat sunny lighting keeps the mood mischievous and summery. Clean top-down perspective, sparse texture, sharp pixel edges, and strong foreground contrast make every arena action immediately readable.
